notes: Both relative clauses are rule 22 fusions: אֲשֶׁר…בָּהּ → wherein and אֲשֶׁר…שָׁמָּה → whither, the latter carrying the directive he as rule 32 directs.
The closing neither rests on the present negative fused with its waw (rule 35).
Neither construct chain writes an article morpheme, so both the's are supplied under rule 29.
